description: The domain's current growth plan: diagnosis, bottleneck, phases and steps. Without a stepKey the structure with all step keys is returned; with a stepKey the full step including rationale, implementation guidance and verification status. On free domains some step details are locked. Responses follow the account language (German by default).

domainId.description: Domain id of one of the user's projects, as returned by list_domains.

stepKey.description: Key of a single step from the plan structure.

name: growth_plan
title: Growth plan
